title: Assemble purity for an isomorphism self-square from its two factors
statement: In the finite-field tower setting [def-pur-tower-geometric-purity-data], let f=jp be smooth of dimension d between separated finite-type Noetherian k-schemes, with j open and p proper. Fix all data of a normalized tower purity presentation a, the tower calculus and exchange laws. For any Cartesian self-square of f with scheme isomorphisms gX,gY, the structure Result is inhabited: pullback-domain witnesses and strict roots, Retagging, invertible exchange and mate, normalization preservation, the exact counit transpose, source naturality, the whole-tower purity square and conjugation all hold.

proof.text: Obtain domain witnesses, normalized-tower preservation and the strict roots from isomorphism inverse image. Obtain Retagging for the chosen purity presentation.

Obtain invertibility of the support exchange, u, and the two orientation/tensor equations. Tensor-pullback naturality followed by the product-morphism composition law combines them into the whole-tower purity square.

Cancel the pulled-back purity isomorphism to obtain conjugation. Its right side is an isomorphism, so fully faithful realization reflects invertibility of each component of the mate. Its naturality and the natural purity isomorphisms give source naturality by conjugation. The adjunction mate formula gives the exact transpose. Compose the normalization assertions with a.support_normalized and a.exceptional_normalized in both orders.
